question: If the volume of a cylinder is 1848 { cm}³ , and its height is 12 cm, find the curved surface area (in {cm}² ).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The relation between the Volume and Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder is: Volume ÷ CSA = (πr²h) ÷ (2πrh) = r ÷ 2.

First, find the radius directly: r = √(Volume ÷ πh)

⇒ r = √(1848 × 7 ÷ (22 × 12)) = √(12936 ÷ 264) = √49 = 7 cm.

Now, substitute r into the ratio relation: CSA = (2 × Volume) ÷ r

⇒ CSA = (2 × 1848) ÷ 7 = 528 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 528 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of the cylinder = 1848 cm³

Height (h) = 12 cm

**Formulas Used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

 

 

 
 
• 
 
 r = 7 cm

 h = 12 cm
 V = 1848 cm3
 Curved Surface Area = 528 cm2

**Calculations:**

⇒ πr²h = 1848

⇒ (22 ÷ 7) × r² × 12 = 1848

⇒ r² = (1848 × 7) ÷ (22 × 12)

⇒ r² = (154 × 7) ÷ 22

⇒ r² = 7 × 7

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = √49 = 7 cm

Now, substitute the values of r and h to find the curved surface area:

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 7 × 12

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 12

⇒ CSA = 44 × 12

⇒ CSA = 528 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 528 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder has one-third of its volume: V = (1 ÷ 3)πr²h.

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere depends entirely on its radius and follows the formula: V = (4 ÷ 3)πr³.
